reviews.review_description: So I recently got a VR set and I came across this game. I am a sucker for tabletops and moba's in general so i had to try this out, plus it's free. I love the looks, it's simple, clean, cute, characters look nice, surrounding like an actual table top, enemies are pretty neat too. I had to get used to the controls but that's also mostly because i needed to get used to the VR in general.  I love the full view and the full zoom in aswell. For me personally i enjoy it a lot, especially when i want to chill, i just put on some lofi beats on the background put my mind on zero and do some solo playing and before i know it time flies by. There are definitely some stuff i hope the dev will either add or adjust so hopefully in the future with some finetuning can only become better.  But if you like cozy games, if you like table tops and if you like moba's then I suggest you give this game a try.

developer_response.body:
Thank you so much for taking the time to write such a thoughtful review!

As a solo indie developer, reading that my game helps someone relax, disconnect from everyday life, and lose track of time genuinely means a lot to me.

I love the idea of playing Reign of Heroes with some lo-fi music in the background!

I'm always looking for ways to improve the game, so please feel free to share any features or adjustments you would love to see. Your feedback really matters to me.

Thank you for giving my little game a chance, and welcome to the wonderful world of VR! ❤️

reviews.review_title: Tabletop MOBA That Packs a Punch! ⚔️
reviews.review_description:
A very cool MOBA experience with excellent execution! Choose your hero, each with their own specialities, and decide how you want to approach the battlefield: carve out a new path, support your teammates or conquer enemy territory.

There are plenty of heroes to choose from, making it fun to experiment with different playstyles and strategies. I particularly enjoy being able to change my viewing angle to oversee the battle, protect my waves of soldiers when needed, or even use them as bait when facing a stronger enemy!

It's addictive even when playing solo, but becomes even more entertaining in multiplayer, where teamwork and strategy really come into play.

A fun and well-executed tabletop MOBA that I can definitely recommend!

developer_response.body:
Wow, thank you so much for such a wonderful and detailed review! ❤️⚔️

As a solo developer, it genuinely makes me happy to see someone enjoying Reign of Heroes and appreciating the little details and strategic possibilities I worked so hard to create!

I especially love that you're experimenting with different heroes, tactics, and camera angles. That's exactly the kind of freedom and creativity I wanted players to experience!

Creating games on my own is a huge adventure, and reviews like yours give me the motivation to keep going, improving, and creating new experiences.

Thank you from the bottom of my heart for playing and supporting my games. It truly means more than you know! ❤️🎮

Please of anyone are reading these reviews DO NOT INSTALL ANY OF THESE GAMES. If you do you'll see what I mean with this review.

1-star.

developer_response.body:
I'm sorry to hear you didn't enjoy the game.

My intention was simply to create a free VR MOBA experience for the community, something fun and different.

Yes, I use AI as a development tool, and I've always been open about that. But creating a VR game still requires countless hours of programming, designing gameplay mechanics, testing, fixing bugs, and making everything work together. AI helps me bring my ideas to life, but it doesn't do all the work for me.

I also want to make something very clear: the reviews on my games are genuine. I do not use alternate accounts to post fake 5-star reviews, and I would appreciate it if you didn't spread false accusations about my work.

I'm a solo developer who genuinely enjoys creating games and sharing them with the VR community. My games may not be for everyone, and that's perfectly fine. I welcome constructive criticism and suggestions for improvement.

Thank you for trying the game, and I wish you all the best.
